title: Reviewing a shift’s timesheets
subtitle: Live staffing board and timesheet report

captions.text: On Venue Offers, open an approved request to see its live pipeline.
Each column shows where staff are, from offered through to clocked out.
Return to Venue Offers and open yesterday’s completed request.
Everyone has clocked out, so the timesheet report is ready.
Select View to open the venue-signed timesheet.
The PDF opens in a new tab, ready to check, download or print.
